label: Form Field
title: Form Field
summary: Use a Form Field to collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it.
corePrinciple: A clear label, a format example, and help when it goes wrong.

sources.title: Use the public Form Field contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (5 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s FormField is a 328 × 94 component with label, start icon, end slot, and support text options; its states are variable modes. The package field is 47 px tall (45 px in Figma). Disabled uses the read-only colours at half opacity instead of Figma’s Disabled colours. Dark mode is not supported. On the web the label names the input; screen readers also announce required and invalid fields and read the support text or error with them. Tab skips a disabled field, and the input narrows to make room for an end action.
